name: Client & Server Prototype Pollution Detector
description: High-impact Prototype Pollution vulnerability auditor for modern JavaScript applications. Evaluates client-side DOM gadget chains and server-side object merge/clone operations (Node.js, Express, Fastify) for __proto__ and constructor.prototype property injections without causing service crashes.
author: Cyber Hashira Security Team

probe_url_params.description: Probe query parameters for __proto__ and constructor.prototype injections

probe_json_body.description: Probe JSON request bodies for nested recursive merge prototype pollution

detect_dom_gadgets.description: Scan client-side scripts for exploitable DOM gadget properties
